description: This file defines the API class MyTimesheetItemAPI, which extends EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI, providing endpoints for listing and updating a user's timesheet entries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes OpenAPI annotations for documentation and a method to retrieve timesheet data with access control checks.

classes.name: MyTimesheetItemAPI
classes.description: API controller for managing user's timesheet entries, including retrieval and updates, with access control based on employee identity.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves a timesheet by ID from the request, verifies existence and access permissions, and returns the Timesheet entity.
